scope: Standing, excavated Great Stupa of Butkara I near Mingora, including the concentric masonry remnants and a selection of low votive bases in its immediate precinct.
era: Present excavated remains at Butkara I.

review.notes: Published Qualla gallery was checked first. Uncertain drawn reconstructions, museum objects and attribution-required photographs were excluded. The excavator’s written measurements and official current site control the Ruins model.
